## GSEA - GOBP

### `gsea.res`

```{r}
dge <- readRDS("Replacing_with_your_file_path")
organism <- "Mus musculus"
seed <- 7788

# ================================================================================

dge <- dge |> dplyr::filter(!is.na(dge$gene))
dge <- dge |> dplyr::filter(!duplicated(dge$gene))
dge <- dge |> dplyr::filter(!is.na(dge$logFC))

stopifnot(exprs = {
  !any(is.na(dge$gene))
  !any(duplicated(dge$gene))
  !any(is.na(dge$logFC))
})

dge <- dge |> dplyr::arrange(desc(logFC))
fc.symbol <- dge |> dplyr::pull(logFC, gene)

pathways <- msigdbr::msigdbr_collections()
paths.gobp <- msigdbr::msigdbr(
  species = "Mus musculus",
  category = "C5",
  subcategory = "GO:BP"
) |>
  dplyr::select(gs_name, gene_symbol) |>
  dplyr::mutate(gs_name = sub("^GOBP_", "", gs_name)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(gs_name = gsub("_", " ", gs_name))

set.seed(seed)
gsea.res <- clusterProfiler::GSEA(
  geneList = fc.symbol,
  TERM2GENE = paths.gobp,
  minGSSize = 10,
  maxGSSize = 500,
  eps = 0,
  pvalueCutoff = 1,
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  by = "fgsea",
  nPermSimple = 100000
)
```

### Enrichment map - q < 0.10

```{r}
emap.in <- gsea.res |>
  dplyr::filter(qvalue < 0.10) |>
  enrichplot::pairwise_termsim()

p1 <- enrichplot::emapplot(
  x = emap.in,
  repel = TRUE,
  showCategory = Inf,
  color = "NES",
  size_category = 1, # Make all dots bigger or smaller, 1 = default
  edge.params = list(min = 0.2),
  color_edge = "grey",
  size_edge = 0.5,
  node_label = c("category", "group", "all", "none")[1],
  pie = "equal",
  group_style = c("ggforce", "polygon")[1],
  cluster.params = list(method = stats::kmeans, label_words_n = 4)
) +
  scale_color_gradient2(
    low = "#0000FF",
    mid = "#FFFFFF",
    high = "#FF0000"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "GOBP pathways, q < 0.10"
  )
```
